name: batman-solo
notes: A single-character query asks what to read about one person, which is a different question from what two characters share. Batman is a regular in Justice League, so co-appearance measures alone rank team books as highly as his own — and they did. The answer should be a book published about Batman: his own title or one of the self-contained stories under his name. A Justice League book is not wrong about him, it is just not about him.
